   CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS

  POLICY AND MANAGEMENT

  MEMORANDUM

 TO:  Priority Setting Ad Hoc (Vice Mayor Nazarian and Councilmember Corman)

 FROM:  Nancy Hunt-Coffey, City Manager

 DATE:  October 28, 2024

 SUBJECT:  Review draft priorities for fiscal year 2025-26

At the August 6, 2024 meeting, the City Council concurred with the recommendations of the
Priority Setting Ad Hoc which included:

  —  Creating a hierarchical list of strategic priorities, goals and workplans that cover a 1-2 year
  period. Other priorities that will take longer than 2 years can be listed separately.
  —  Priorities should be achievable, measurable and action oriented.
  —  The timing of the priority setting session should occur in the fall, before the budget
  process begins.
  —  A biannual check in should occur in the spring before the budget is adopted, since some
  priorities will require budget approval by City Council.

The Council authorized the ad hoc to further develop strategic priorities areas, associated draft
goals and work plan items for fiscal year 2025-26, and asked that the final draft priorities return
to the City Council in the fall for adoption.

Staff has developed the draft priorities, goals and work plan items which are included in
Attachment 1. For the most part, the priorities were listed if they require substantial investment by
the City, in terms of capital and/or staff time, and/or they will have a meaningful impact on the
community.

Recommendation
The Council ad hoc members are asked to provide feedback on the attached draft priorities,
goals, and work plan items for fiscal year 2025-26. Once these items are finalized by the ad
hoc, they will be brought to the full City Council in November.
